source: American National Election Studies, 2016 Time Series Study, via Ryan Burge (github.com/ryanburge).
method: Population: respondents with a post-election interview, weighted by V160102 (post-election full-sample weight). Groups from V161265x (major religion summary) with Latter-day Saints pulled out of 'Other religion' via V161264x == 301; Black Protestant dropped (fewer than 30 post-election respondents). Share agreeing strongly or somewhat that the newer lifestyles are contributing to the breakdown of our society, V162208. Refused/don't know/no post interview excluded from the base. Latter-day Saint n=43 with a post-election interview. 'All U.S. adults' includes Black Protestants.
